name: Sariena Hadley
source:
A woman who holds the position of court magician.

She also serves as the commander of the Magician Division.

Although she is a magician, she is also known as the Magic Knight because she wears armor and goes to the front lines as a knight.

She likes to make clear distinctions between black and white, and is not satisfied unless everything is orderly.

Perhaps because of this, she also has a strong sense of justice, and her actions based on the principle of immediately killing evil often lead to conflict with Xenovia.

Her sword skills are only average, but her strength is increased many times over by combining her skills with magic.
